# z-core-frontier-rooms

> Game room service: HTTP control plane (Fiber), **ENet UDP data plane** (primary), WebSocket for debugging. Authoritative room state, ticket admission, binary wire codec for a Godot client.

Documentation for implementing a **client** (Godot / AI agent):

- [Client protocol index](client-protocol/README.md) — e2e flow, Godot checklist
- [HTTP control plane](client-protocol/http.md) — REST JSON, ticket, auth
- **[ENet data plane](client-protocol/enet.md)** — **primary transport** (UDP :7777, admit, reliable)
- [Realtime overview](client-protocol/realtime.md) — shared frame format; WebSocket smoke test
- [State sync](client-protocol/state-sync.md) — master, ticks, input/entities/RPC
- [Wire errors](client-protocol/errors.md) — OpCodes 0x40+, 0x60+, 0x70+, notifications 0x80+
- [Wire state codec](wire-state-codec.md) — binary payload layout (BE, maps)

Source of truth on divergence: the Go codec `internal/adapter/realtime/codec/` and tests `tests/adapter/realtime/codec/`. ENet: `internal/delivery/enet/`.

Server architecture: [architecture.md](architecture.md). Package READMEs — [../README.md](../README.md).
